**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline).**

- **Renewal mechanic** sits in Section 13 (p0078), not in sec-5 as the planner suspected: initial 1-year term, then "renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods," exitable by either party on written non-renewal notice "no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year."
- **Notice window = 30 days**, well inside the fallback ceiling of 60 days and equal to the preferred 30-day opt-out; **renewal term = 12 months**, so no walk-away multi-year auto-renewal.
- **Price uplift:** no clause grants TrueLink a unilateral increase right — fees run off the Exhibit A/B schedules, other-service fees are "determined by the parties" (p0045), amendments need a signed writing (p0081), and Section 6 (p0047) gives us a one-year freeze plus a most-favoured-rate covenant. The conditional cap element is therefore not engaged.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no Vendor 60-day pre-renewal reminder and no express CPI/3% cap on post-year-one rate changes — minor shortfalls against preferred wording only.
